_readme: Curated list of existing, planned, under-construction, stalled or cancelled desalination plants: Colombia, Bahamas, Caribbean, South America, Africa, Europe, Israel and India. Coordinates marked approx:true are the town/community, not the plant parcel. Every entry has a source URL. Updated 2026-11-07.
